messages.subject: Bhavana | GCC Mining & Industrial Executive Profile | Government Relations & ESG
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Dalal,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC and international leadership mandates across mining, industrials, government-facing functions and regulated businesses.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation. Earlier in my career, I spent five years in regulated financial services with Scotiabank Guyana.

Your executive-search work across the Middle East, Europe and Africa, together with coverage of industrial, public-sector and government mandates, aligns closely with the leadership profile I am taking to the GCC.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

I have attached a tailored executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
